B2THEWORLD

A demonstration of Eval360 configured around B2THEWORLD's own work — transformative education for children affected by war, across {{COUNTRY_LIST}}, through a partnership-based member school model.

Built from B2THEWORLD's three source documents, which disagree in {{CONFLICTS}} places and leave {{GAPS}} sections blank. Rather than quietly picking a number, this system shows every difference, quotes both documents, records who decided — and where a section was never filled in, prints the question that would fill it.

Open the system {{SCREENS}} screens: the plan, the schools, the people, school quality, the team's own culture, the money, and {{REPORTS}} reports built from the same figures. Single page · no login The user guide {{CHAPTERS}} chapters and {{FIGURES}} figures. Not a screenshot anywhere — every figure is a live screen, generated by the system from its own records.
